records.text: Owens said Kip Crofts, Maycee Crofts’s paternal uncle, was arrested by Nampa police in June of 2025 on a warrant charging sexual abuse of a minor over alleged conduct at a school in 2024; she explicitly said Maycee was not responsible for her family’s conduct.

appearances.snippet: And I want to be clear, this thread that I came across has nothing to do with Macy (Macy Crofts). You can't control what your family does. ... But, you know, when I learned that her father had passed suddenly and... that her family was involved in law enforcement in Idaho, I did come across a very interesting case of her uncle in June of 2025. ... at a school. And I want to get these charges exactly right. Her uncle is Kip Crofts. ... A warrant was issued charging Kip Crofts, so that's her dad's brother, with sexual abuse of a minor. ... The girl was 14 years old. He was arrested without incident in June of 2025 by Nampa police officers. ... When he arrived at his job, that's when they apprehended him.
